an3.40:1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati
an3.40:1.6: na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:1.7: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:1.8: apica khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:1.9: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an3.40:1.10: ahañceva kho pana yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito tādisake vā kāme pariyeseyyaṃ tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ na metaṃ assa paṭirūpanti
an3.40:1.12: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti
an3.40:1.13: so attānaṃyeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti sāvajjaṃ pajahati anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
an3.40:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati
an3.40:2.3: na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:2.4: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na itibhavābhavahetu āgārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:2.5: apica khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:2.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an3.40:2.7: ahañceva kho pana evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāmavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ mahā kho panāyaṃ lokasannivāso
an3.40:2.8: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno
an3.40:2.9: te dūratopi passanti āsannāpi na dissanti cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānanti
an3.40:2.11: passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehīti
an3.40:2.12: devatāpi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paricittaviduniyo
an3.40:2.13: tā dūratopi passanti āsannāpi na dissanti cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānanti
an3.40:2.15: passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehīti
an3.40:2.17: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti
an3.40:2.18: so lokaṃyeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti sāvajjaṃ pajahati anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
an3.40:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati
an3.40:3.3: na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:3.4: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:3.5: apica khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:3.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an3.40:3.7: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
an3.40:3.8: santi kho pana sabrahmacārī jānaṃ passaṃ viharanti
an3.40:3.9: ahañceva kho pana evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajito samāno kusīto vihareyyaṃ pamatto na metaṃ assa paṭirūpanti
an3.40:3.11: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti
an3.40:3.12: so dhammaṃyeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti sāvajjaṃ pajahati anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
